purpose: 학생 문제 화면에서 물높이를 동적으로 보여 주는 투명 물통 프레임

generation.prompt:
Create one original raster UI asset for a Korean elementary math game.

SUBJECT
A single empty transparent measuring-water container, front-facing and perfectly centered. It should feel like a friendly classroom science vessel: a sturdy clear glass/acrylic body with a softly rounded rectangular silhouette, a wide open rim, a stable rounded base, and three subtle unlabeled etched tick marks. No handle, no cap, no water, no liquid, no numbers, no letters, no words, no logo, no mascot, no background scene.

FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENT
The vessel will be used as a foreground frame in a web game while a separate dynamic water layer rises behind it. Therefore the entire interior cavity must be genuinely transparent alpha, including the area from the bottom inside edge to the open top. The outside background must also be true transparent alpha. Keep only the glass rim, side walls, base, highlights, and very subtle refractions. Do not paint an opaque gray or white fill inside the cavity. Leave broad clear interior space.

STYLE
Polished high-quality 2D game UI asset, crisp glossy sticker-like rendering that harmonizes with bright Mathmon elementary-game visuals, but the vessel is an object, not a character. Warm off-white and pale cyan glass edges with dark navy-violet outline accents, clean high contrast at small sizes, simple geometry, child-friendly, no photorealism, no 3D clay/toy look, no painterly texture. Orthographic front view with no perspective tilt.

COMPOSITION
Portrait canvas, vessel fills about 78% of canvas height and 62% of canvas width, at least 9% safe transparent margin on every side, completely visible and not cropped. Symmetric silhouette. Use a 2:3 portrait aspect ratio suitable for downscaling to a 512×768 source PNG.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
No text, no numerals, no measurement labels, no water, no liquid, no bubbles, no scene, no tabletop, no shadow outside the vessel, no solid background, no checkerboard pattern, no border around the canvas, no watermark.
